prior_summary: Contract-aware learned action diffusion with a three-member action-conditioned outcome ensemble, causal horizon-progress conditioning, phase-gated rotated-corner containment shaping and preservation of already achieved goals. Goal energy has a zero-cost feasible region rather than a pad-center target. Opening, retreat and the red-to-blue transition retain ordinary demonstration supervision.
applicable_conditions: World-state unstack_sort observations in the demonstrated two-pad layout. Covers all assigned expanded slices: open pickup approach, in-progress grasp/lift, transport, lowering, attainment while pinched, opening, retreat, red-to-blue approach and final settling. Requires two causal 47-dimensional observations with qpos/qvel, TCP and both object wxyz poses and both goals. Explicit caller tags and past commands are not available through this numerical interface; intent is inferred from both objects, pad status, finger state and short-term motion.
termination_guidance: Evaluate actual observed poses, not predictions: all eight rotated cube corners must project inside each 0.12 m square pad and each object center must be within 0.011 m of goal z. Both colors are required; a single satisfying observation completes the task without mandatory release or clearance. For physical composition, separately continue learned opening/retreat until fingers are near 0.040 m each and the object remains at its pad while TCP separates. Red transitions toward exposed blue; final blue retreat is supported near TCP z=0.300 m. Early transfer requires a successor that can complete the matching release/transition.
limitations: No images, IK, collision guarantees, force/contact sensor, explicit tag input or command-history input. Only two observations disambiguate direction and finger state. Demonstrations are centered and almost upright, so rotated near-edge placement tolerance is mathematical contract information, not demonstrated robustness. Ensemble uncertainty is an uncalibrated support proxy. Fixed DDPM sampling is unguided at runtime; outcome energy is amortized into the denoiser during training. Horizon-limited predictors cannot certify long-term stability or successful recovery. Geometry and physical handoff are distinct.

config.inference_guidance: none; trained amortized outcome shaping with unchanged DDPM epsilon interface
config.phase_gate: demonstrated future attainment and current observed achievement; causal predicted progress conditions the denoiser
config.segmentation: all 24 assigned expanded slices unchanged; no phase filtering, relabeling of ownership or per-skill normalization
config.ablation: Set arrival_energy and preservation_energy weights to zero for a matched outcome-auxiliary model without goal shaping; not evaluated here.
